title: combined_state() and session_handler silently return fake state on store error
description: combined_state() (lib.rs:87-94) returns the hardcoded string 's-0-s-0-s-0' if get_all_states() fails. session_handler (lib.rs:102-104) similarly returns 's-0-s-0-s-0' if the store mutex is poisoned. Neither logs a warning. The consequence: the daemon appears healthy and returns HTTP 200 for session requests, but all state values are fake. SSE clients will receive state-change events but then find no delta when they call /changes. The daemon will appear stuck to users without any indication of the degraded state. Fix: log a tracing::error\! when falling back to the stub state. If mutex is poisoned, propagate a 500 rather than serving a fake session.
